source.manualTitle: Whirlpool Duet Sport Front-Load Dryer (Job Aid L-79)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Access thermal components (gas)
steps.body: Remove toe panel. Gas dryer heating path: thermal fuse → thermal cut-off → high-limit → gas valve coils.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Remove toe panel. Gas dryer heating path: thermal fuse → thermal cut-off → high-limit → gas valve coils.

steps.title: TEST #3b — thermal fuse continuity
steps.body: Thermal fuse in series with gas valve: 0 Ω = good. Open = replace fuse (see w8178559-thermal-fuse).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Thermal fuse in series with gas valve: 0 Ω = good. Open = replace fuse (see w8178559-thermal-fuse).

steps.title: TEST #3c — thermal cut-off continuity
steps.body: Thermal cut-off shows continuity (0 Ω)? Open = replace cut-off and high-limit.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Thermal cut-off shows continuity (0 Ω)? Open = replace cut-off and high-limit.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace thermal cut-off and high-limit thermostat.

steps.title: High-limit thermostat continuity
steps.body: Measure continuity red wire to blue wire at high-limit thermostat. Open = replace high-limit and cut-off.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure continuity red wire to blue wire at high-limit thermostat. Open = replace high-limit and cut-off.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace high-limit thermostat and thermal cut-off.

steps.title: TEST #3d — gas valve coils
steps.body: Perform gas valve coil resistance checks (procedure w8178559-gas-valve). Also verify ignitor 50–250 Ω if flame never appears.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Perform gas valve coil resistance checks (procedure w8178559-gas-valve). Also verify ignitor 50–250 Ω if flame never appears.

steps.title: Replace cut-off & high-limit
steps.oemOutcome: Replace thermal cut-off and high-limit thermostat; inspect vent path.

steps.title: Gas heat path verified at components
steps.oemOutcome: Thermal limits and gas valve coils within spec — if still no heat, replace MCE.
